rdfs:label: range
rdfs:comment: States that every value of a property is an instance of the given class or datatype — an inference rule, not a validation constraint.
notes: Object-side inference (not validation — use SHACL to reject data). `foaf:knows` has range `foaf:Person`. May also point at an XSD datatype (`xsd:string`, `xsd:dateTime`) for literal-valued properties. Like `domain`, multiple range declarations mean intersection — the value is inferred to be an instance of all of them.

history.note: Reframed rdfs:range as an inference rule, not a validation constraint.
